items.title: Micron Announces Board of Directors Retirement
items.summary: BOISE, Idaho, Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Micron Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: MU) today announced that Linnie M. Haynesworth has informed the Company that she will retire from its board of directors at the annual shareholders meeting expected to be held on January 14, 2027. Haynesworth joined Micron’s board in February 2021, bringing more than 30 years of technology experience, including deep expertise in aerospace and cybersecurity.
